spec.title: theia PROP-002: Upstream identity and tree layout

status.comment: answers to TYPE-AREA-IDENTITY and TYPE-AREA-LAYOUT; facts 01, 02, 10

facts.THEIA-PIN-TAGS: Release tags match `v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+`; the rolling tag `next` is mutable and a pin resolver ignores it (`01-version-and-sha.md`, tag shape). A pin is `tag@sha@date` as everywhere; a pin on a master commit between tags is allowed and is written with the nearest reachable tag plus the sha (`v1.75.0@c8926e4d…`).
facts.THEIA-VERSION-SOURCE: The upstream version is read from `lerna.json` (`version`, fixed mode), not from the root `package.json`, which is the private `@theia/monorepo` at `0.0.0`; every `@theia/*` package carries the same literal version (`01`, "Where the version is written").
facts.THEIA-TREE-FINGERPRINT: `check-tree` fingerprints: root `package.json` named `@theia/monorepo` with `workspaces` covering `packages/*` and `dev-packages/*`; `lerna.json` with `npmClient: "npm"`; `packages/core/package.json` named `@theia/core` at the version of `lerna.json`; the anchor commit reachable from the pin (`01`, `02`).

facts.THEIA-OWN-ROOT: The own root is a workspace package directory: `typeConfig.ownRoot` defaults to `packages/<name>` and must match one of the workspace globs of the root `package.json` (`dev-packages/*`, `packages/*`, `examples/*`); the type refuses a root outside them (`CK-E-CONFIG`). A package under `packages/` is what the `theiaext` scripts, the generated tsconfig references and the `nls-extract` glob already cover (`10-downstream-own-package.md`, "Placement").
facts.THEIA-OWN-PACKAGE-SHAPE: The own root is an npm package with `theiaExtensions` (the ten entry kinds of `extension-package.ts:22-33`), `version` equal to the monorepo version, `dependencies` on the `@theia/*` packages it uses at the exact same version, the `theiaext` scripts (`lint`, `build`, `watch`, `clean`, `compile`, `test`) and `@theia/ext-scripts` as a dev dependency, its own `.eslintrc.js` and `tsconfig.json` (a package without them is not linted at all - `08`); the skeleton of `examples/api-provider-sample/package.json` is the reference (`10`, "The skeleton").
facts.THEIA-APPLICATION-ROOT: A product's application is a second directory the delta owns, `typeConfig.applicationRoot` (default `applications/<name>` or an `examples/*` slot), whose `package.json` is the overlay target of PROP-003. The type materializes both directories the way the `vscode` type materializes its own root: mirrored by content from the delta, excluded from the drift guard.
facts.THEIA-CLEANUP-WHITELIST: Build outputs the fresh pass may remove: `node_modules/`, `**/lib/` of workspace packages, `**/src-gen/`, `**/gen-webpack*.js` if present, `.eslintcache`, `*.tsbuildinfo`, `plugins/` downloaded by `theia download:plugins` (`02-repository-layout.md`, runtime folders and build outputs).
facts.THEIA-FORBIDDEN-TARGETS: Never patched: `dev-packages/cli/patches/**` (upstream's own patches of `node_modules`, applied on every install by `theia-patch`), `package-lock.json` (regenerated by install), `src-gen/**` (generated). A patch of `lerna.json` or of the root `package.json` workspace globs is a graft of the constant set and needs a decision record.
facts.THEIA-MARKER-FORMS: Marker comment forms are the engine's by extension; Theia adds none. The SPDX header rule of upstream's lint applies to every `.ts`/`.tsx` under a linted package (PROP-005), which shapes where a marker block may sit in an own file: below the header.
